items.name: comicwise (workspace)
items.relevance: Shared comic reader; Stripe + NextAuth + Tailwind patterns

items.title: Multi-stage Docker Build
items.detail: 3-stage (deps → builder → runner) with `output: "standalone"` cuts image from ~1.6GB to ~200MB. Run Prisma migrations in a separate init container to avoid multi-replica race conditions.

items.title: Prisma in Docker
items.detail: `bunx prisma generate` must run during build. Copy `prisma/` directory into final stage for migrations at startup. Alpine needs `libc6-compat` for native modules; use `sh` not `bash`.

items.title: Standalone Output
items.detail: Enable `output: "standalone"` in `next.config.ts` for minimal production images. Essential for Docker deployment size optimization.

items.title: Singleton Client Pattern (Critical)
items.detail: Store PrismaClient on `globalThis` to survive hot reloads and prevent connection pool exhaustion. Default pool size is `num_cpus * 2 + 1`.

items.title: Connection Pooling for Serverless
items.detail: Start with `connection_limit=1` and `pool_timeout=30` in DATABASE_URL, optimize upward. For scale, use Prisma Accelerate (HTTP-based pooling, global caching). PgBouncer transaction pooling saves serverless connections.

items.title: Schema Design
items.detail: Use native DB types (`@db.VarChar`, `@db.Text`, `@db.Timestamptz`), strategic indexes (`@@index([comicId, chapterNumber])`), CUID over UUID, `relationLoadStrategy: "join"` for relational queries.

items.title: Migration Strategy
items.detail: `prisma migrate dev` in development, `prisma migrate deploy` in production. Never `db:push` in production. Run migrations via separate init container.

items.title: Performance
items.detail: Use `relationLoadStrategy: "join"`, batch nested creates (single round-trip since Prisma 5.11), enable fullTextSearch/Index preview features, monitor slow queries via Prisma log config.

items.title: Project Structure (2026)
items.detail: Route groups: `(auth)/`, `(reader)/` for layout isolation. Server Components by default. Server Actions for mutations. Zod validation at every API boundary — never `as` cast.

items.title: Type Safety
items.detail: Next.js has an "inconsistent" type safety story. Use Zod for runtime validation, infer types from Prisma (`Prisma.UserGetPayload`), avoid type assertions without validation.

items.title: Common Pitfalls
items.detail: Forgetting `"use client"` causes hydration errors. Stripe webhook body must use `req.text()` not `req.json()`. Middleware must exclude `/api/webhooks/*` paths. Missing `output: "standalone"` creates 1.6GB images. Mutate via Server Actions, not client-side API calls.

items.title: Performance
items.detail: Standalone output reduces Docker 8x. Turbopack (15.5+/16.x) 400% faster dev rebuilds. Streaming via `loading.tsx` + Suspense. Prefetch next chapter via TanStack Query or `<link rel="prefetch">`. Lazy load non-visible reader components.

items.title: v5 Architecture
items.detail: Config moved to root `auth.ts`. Single `auth()` function call replaces `getServerSession`/`getToken`. Built-in CSRF protection — never disable. Middleware for route protection; server-side session verification in API routes and Server Actions.

items.title: Best Practices
items.detail: Never trust client-side auth state. Use `auth()` in Server Components, `useSession()` in Client Components. Rate limit auth endpoints. Module augmentation via `next-auth.d.ts` for custom user properties (roles, etc.).

items.title: Edge Runtime
items.detail: Prisma client needs special setup for Edge middleware. Use `@prisma/adapter-pg` or connection pooling for Edge compatibility.

items.title: Stripe Webhooks (Critical Pattern)
items.detail: Use `req.text()` for raw body BEFORE `stripe.webhooks.constructEvent()`. Never use `req.json()`. Handle events: `checkout.session.completed`, `invoice.paid`, `customer.subscription.updated`. Idempotency via DB event ID deduplication in transaction.

items.title: PayPal Orders v2 API
items.detail: Client renders PayPal buttons → buyer approves → client sends order ID to server → server calls `POST /v2/checkout/orders/{id}/capture` with `PayPal-Request-Id` header (6-hour idempotency). Always verify `status === 'COMPLETED'` server-side. Sandbox vs live URLs differ.

items.title: Dual Payment Architecture
items.detail: Stripe (primary) + PayPal (secondary). Unified `Subscription` model with `provider` + `providerId` + `@@unique([provider, providerId])`. Track both `stripeCustomerId` and `paypalPayerId` on User. Webhook handlers share idempotency pattern.

items.title: Security
items.detail: Stripe: `constructEvent()` with raw body. PayPal: verify `PAYPAL-AUTH-ALGO`/`PAYPAL-CERT-URL` headers against PayPal's cert chain. Both: database transaction deduplication for idempotency. Rate limit payment endpoints. Exclude webhook routes from auth middleware.

items.title: App Router Setup
items.detail: Use `createUploadthing` from `uploadthing/next`. Define FileRouter with `f({ image: { maxFileSize: "4MB", maxFileCount: 20 } })`. Middleware for auth validation. `createRouteHandler` for App Router integration.

items.title: Best Practices
items.detail: 4TB free tier on R2 backend. Server-side file type/size validation via middleware before upload. `onUploadComplete` callback for database records. Direct browser→R2 uploads bypass origin bandwidth.

items.title: WebSocket Limitation
items.detail: WebSockets do NOT work on Vercel serverless (stateless). Requires custom Node server (Fly.io, Railway, custom VPS).

items.title: SSE Alternative
items.detail: Server-Sent Events work on Vercel/App Router. Lower overhead, unidirectional (server→client). Perfect for notifications, chapter release alerts, live updates. Use `TextEncoderStream` in Route Handler.

items.title: Recommendation for rhixe_scans
items.detail: Use SSE for Vercel deployment. If WebSocket required for bidirectional chat/collaboration, deploy custom Node server on Fly.io with `ws` library.

items.title: Configuration
items.detail: Use `next/jest` wrapper in `jest.config.ts`. Mock `next/navigation` hooks (`useRouter`, `usePathname`, `useSearchParams`). Configure `moduleNameMapper` for `@/` path aliases matching `tsconfig.json`. Add `@testing-library/jest-dom` in setup file.

items.title: Server Component Testing
items.detail: Jest does NOT support async Server Components. Test synchronous Server/Client Components with RTL. Use E2E tests (Playwright) for async Server Components.

items.title: Best Practices
items.detail: Mock only external APIs (fetch) and Next.js modules. Don't mock code under test. Use `waitFor`/`act` for async operations. Check coverage with `bun run test -- --coverage`. Ensure React 19 + Jest version compatibility.

items.title: Webhook Verification
items.detail: Stripe: raw body + signature. PayPal: header/cert validation. Both: DB transaction deduplication for idempotency.

items.title: Content Protection
items.detail: Verify subscription server-side before serving paywalled content. UploadThing secure URL tokens for comic pages. Preview gate: server-side filter shows first N pages to non-subscribers. CDN referrer checking for download prevention.

items.title: Auth & API Security
items.detail: NextAuth v5 CSRF built-in. Zod validation at EVERY API boundary. Rate limit auth + payment endpoints. Generic error messages in production (no stack traces). Never commit `.env`; use Zod schema validation at startup.

items.title: Supply Chain
items.detail: Regular `bun audit` / `bun audit`. Dependabot/Renovate for automated updates. Vet new dependencies carefully.

items.title: Database
items.detail: Composite indexes (`@@index([comicId, chapterNumber])`), Prisma JOIN strategy (`relationLoadStrategy: "join"`), prepared statements (default), monitor queries >1s via Prisma logs.

items.title: Application
items.detail: TanStack Query caching for listings, invalidate on chapter release. UploadThing CDN + Next.js `<Image>` for responsive images. Prefetch next chapter via `queryClient.prefetchQuery()` or `<link rel="prefetch">`. SSE over WebSocket for serverless real-time. Streaming with `loading.tsx` + Suspense boundaries.

items.title: Deployment
items.detail: Standalone Docker output (~200MB vs ~1.6GB). CDN for static assets (`public/`, `.next/static/`). Multi-stage builds. Init containers for migrations (no race conditions).

items.title: Image Delivery (Comic-specific)
items.detail: Cloudflare R2 (S3-compatible, zero egress) + Cloudflare Images for on-the-fly resizing/variants (WebP/AVIF). Presigned URLs for direct browser upload to R2. Workers + Images transform API for automatic `srcset` generation.

items.avoidance: Use SSE or custom Node server (Fly.io)
DB event ID deduplication in transaction
Enable in next.config.ts for minimal Docker images
Use `"use server"` functions for all mutations
